# Milestone v0.1.2

> **Status**: Planning
> **Target date**: Q3 2026
> **Theme**: Performance + a new audit category
> **Branch**: `main` (no separate release branch for 0.1.2)

## Overview

The v0.1.2 release is a **minor** release that adds:

1. **C7 audit category** (citation context validation) — the
   7th audit check, designed to catch "ceremonial" citations
   that are listed but never engaged with.
2. **Audit-cache layer** — a content-addressed cache for
   audit results, so re-running on unchanged content is
   instant.

This milestone is **community-contribution-friendly**:
both issues are well-scoped, have clear acceptance criteria,
and are designed to be 1-3 days of work each.

## Issues in this milestone

### #16 — C7 audit category (citation context)

**Source**: [`.github/issues/16-c7-citation-context.md`](./issues/16-c7-citation-context.md)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | Enhancement |
| Area | audit (new category) |
| Effort | Medium (1-3 days) |
| Difficulty | Moderate (regex + heuristics) |
| Risk | Low (additive change) |
| Labels | `enhancement`, `area:c7`, `milestone:v0.1.2` |

**Summary**: Add a 7th check function `check_c7_citation_context`
that classifies each `\cite` as "engaged" or "ceremonial" based
on the surrounding sentence. Per-paper `c7_max_ceremonial`
threshold (default 2) controls when to flag.

**Acceptance criteria**:
- [ ] `check_c7_citation_context` in `verify_TEMPLATE.py`
- [ ] `c7_settings` block in `paper_configs.py` (per paper)
- [ ] 6+ unit tests in `tests/test_c7_citation_context.py`
- [ ] Meta-test reports 8/8 (after `inject_bug8` added)
- [ ] Paper 1 and Paper 5 still pass with C7 enabled
- [ ] `engineering_notes_verify_template.md` §11 added
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` v0.1.2 entry added

---

### #17 — Audit-cache layer

**Source**: [`.github/issues/17-audit-cache.md`](./issues/17-audit-cache.md)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | Enhancement |
| Area | performance (caching) |
| Effort | Medium (1-3 days) |
| Difficulty | Moderate (SQLite + invalidation) |
| Risk | Medium (cache invalidation bugs) |
| Labels | `enhancement`, `area:performance`, `milestone:v0.1.2` |

**Summary**: Add a content-addressed SQLite cache for audit
results, with `--no-cache` / `--clear-cache` / `--cache-info`
CLI flags. Cache hit should be < 5 ms; cache miss is the
current ~150 ms.

**Acceptance criteria**:
- [ ] `src/tmaudit/cache.py` with `CacheDB` class
- [ ] `tmaudit verify --paper N` does cache lookup
- [ ] `--no-cache`, `--clear-cache`, `--cache-info` CLI flags
- [ ] Invalidate on content change (sha256 mismatch)
- [ ] Invalidate on version change (tmaudit upgrade)
- [ ] 5+ unit tests in `tests/test_cache.py`
- [ ] Cache hit < 5 ms (measured)
- [ ] `engineering_notes_verify_template.md` §12 added

## Cross-cutting acceptance criteria

- [ ] All 53 existing tests still pass.

- [ ] `RELEASE_NOTES_v0.1.2.md` is written following the
      same format as `RELEASE_NOTES_v0.1.1.md`.
- [ ] No new bugs introduced that the meta-test doesn't catch.

## How to contribute

1. Pick an issue from the table above.
2. Comment on the issue: "I'd like to work on this."
3. Fork the repo, create a branch (`feature/issue-16-c7` or
   similar), implement, and open a PR.
4. Reference the issue in the PR body using GitHub's
   `Fixes #16` syntax.
5. Wait for review and merge.

The PR will be auto-assigned to `@liumingrui` per
[`.github/CODEOWNERS`](../CODEOWNERS).
